enemies.name: Goblin Captain
enemies.description: The Captain stands before the throne — twin blades drawn, eyes burning. "You will not pass!"
enemies.successText: Your strike lands true — the Captain reels back!
enemies.failText: The Captain laughs and slashes you twice in return.

enemies.name: Goblin Guard
enemies.description: A guard shrieks the alarm and lunges with a rusty spear!
enemies.successText: Your blade silences the alarm — guard down!

enemies.name: Goblin Guard
enemies.description: A second guard charges with a notched cleaver!
enemies.successText: You parry and counter — clean kill!

enemies.name: Goblin Archer
enemies.description: An archer pops out from a barricade and looses an arrow!
enemies.successText: You close the distance and end them!
enemies.failText: An arrow finds a gap — sharp pain.
